title: Welcome to the Tech Office
summary: An introduction to Project White Wash and the Tech Office.

steps.title: Introduction
steps.body: Welcome to the Tech Office. Project White Wash is designed to keep important training materials, resources, and planning tools in one place.

steps.title: Explore the Application
steps.body: Use the sidebar to navigate between the Dashboard, Transfer Planner, Tutorials, and Software sections.

steps.title: Continue Learning
steps.body: Open the tutorial library to find instructions for common tasks. This introductory tutorial is sample content and can be replaced with your official training material.

title: Organizing Office Files
summary: Basic guidelines for keeping your workspace organized.

steps.title: Create a Folder Structure
steps.body: Use clearly named folders to keep approved documents organized by subject or purpose.

steps.title: Use Consistent File Names
steps.body: Choose descriptive file names so information is easy to locate later.

steps.title: Protect Sensitive Information
steps.body: Store confidential records only in approved locations and follow your organization's data-handling procedures.

title: Finding Essential Software
summary: Learn to use the software resources directory.

steps.title: Open the Software Section
steps.body: Select Software from the Project White Wash sidebar.

steps.title: Find a Resource
steps.body: Browse the available software entries and read their descriptions.

steps.title: Open the Official Website
steps.body: Click Open Website to launch an approved resource in your default browser. Internet access may be required.
